briefs.culture: 连接两端的支撑关系传达善念，拱下开放空间传达善心，桥面延伸传达善行。
briefs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: ONE original corporate logo SYMBOL for Chinese brand 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO, company 达州礼林生态科技有限责任公司. Its scope includes software, information systems, engineering, ecological and practical services; represent a coherent corporate brand, NOT a collage of business icons. Values 善心、善念、善行 guide accepting space, thoughtful structural joining and outward purposeful action. Graphic-first contemporary identity, memorable silhouette, medium optical weight with generous white openings, professionally balanced, easy to reproduce. This is a NEW independent design with no prior image as a reference. Construction direction: A COMPACT WIDE DOUBLE-ARCH BRIDGE symbol with ONE continuous upper deck that breaks into a short upward open hook at its right end. Two DIFFERENT arch apertures below share a central forked pier, subtle dot source on left incorporated in the deck. Rounded inside arches, crisply squared outside deck. Pure graphic twin-arch silhouette; no literal cables, river, traffic, people, shadow or picture frame. Palette: Bright burnt orange deck with navy-blue shared pier and turquoise small face. Output ONE centered standalone emblem on clean pure WHITE with generous margins. NO rendered company name or text: wordmark will be consistently laid out separately. No comparison board, captions, labels, mockups, texture, shadows, 3D rendering, generic corporate swoosh or extraneous pictograms. Do not copy any existing brand. Finish as crisp flat vector-like artwork with broad clean shapes.
